settings.question: What does Tile & Paint Calculator cost?
settings.answer: Nothing. One plan, free, with every feature, unlimited products and unlimited calculations. The current pricing is always on the Shopify App Store listing.

settings.question: How does the tile buy box work out the boxes?
settings.answer: It multiplies the area by one plus the overage, divides by the coverage per box and rounds up to whole boxes, never fewer than one. The result line says how much those boxes cover and how many pieces that is, and the total comes from the box price. A shopper can also type a number of boxes and see the area the other way round.

settings.question: Can I change the overage options?
settings.answer: Yes. The overage choices and the default are settings in the app and in the theme editor; 10, 15 and 20 percent come out of the box. The area unit is store wide, square feet or square metres, and dimensions convert to inches or centimetres to match.

settings.question: How does the paint buy box choose containers?
settings.answer: Area times coats divided by coverage per gallon gives the paint needed. The container policy decides how that becomes products in the cart: the lowest price that covers the job, the fewest containers, or an exact fit. Container sizes live on the variants with their unit, gallon, quart, litre or kilo, so a 5 kilo pail of clay finish is handled like a 5 gallon pail of eggshell.

settings.question: Where does the sample button go?
settings.answer: Wherever your customers look for it. On the product page it can sit above the calculator as a card, under Add to cart, or inside the opened panel. On collection and product cards the Sample quick-add block adds it inline or over the image. The sample comes from a linked sample product or a Sample variant, and the price shows next to it.

settings.question: How does sample tracking work?
settings.answer: Turn it on and the app watches orders. A sample order starts a journey; a later full-size order of the same product by the same email converts it, and a journey that goes quiet lapses. The Samples page shows the journeys and the share that converted. Klaviyo receives the events and the customer carries the tags sample-ordered, sample-lapsed and sample-converted, so your own flows do the follow-up. The app sends no email or SMS itself.

settings.question: What is Catalog health?
settings.answer: Rules you set per collection, tag or product type that say which values a product must carry: coverage, pieces, dimensions, a working sample. The audit runs nightly and whenever you save, and lists every product that falls short with a fix field in the row, so the buy box never meets a product it cannot calculate.

settings.question: Does it change my theme files?
settings.answer: No. The buy boxes, spec rows, quick-add and cart banner are theme app extension blocks you place in the theme editor. They take your theme’s fonts; colours, radius and every label are block settings. Removing the app removes the blocks.

settings.question: Does it work with the other Conspire apps?
settings.answer: Yes, side by side. B2B Wishlist Project Planner adds Add to Project next to the buy box so a designer keeps each job as a project by room. B2B Onboarding & Wholesale runs the trade application and tier, and the sample allowance can give trade customers their own number of free samples. Each app also works on its own.
